_comment: What this gate emits against each tree here. Machine-readable because prose in GATE.md is not a declaration: a stated count nothing checks drifts the moment a case is added, which four of these had done.

cases: ci/gates/dangling.py: names rule note 'docs/method/rules/nowhere.md', which does not exist
docs/code/banned-patterns/planned-without-status.md: declares a planned gate and links no work that builds it
docs/code/banned-patterns/planned-without-status.md: declares a planned gate but is not marked status: planned
docs/code/rules/preferences/gated-in-quarantine.md: names a gate but sits in the quarantine, which is for unenforced pre
docs/method/rules/claims-absent-gate.md: claims gate 'ci/gates/does_not_exist.py', which the repository does not run
docs/method/rules/no-marker.md: names neither a gate nor the no-gate marker
docs/method/rules/ungated-outside-quarantine.md: carries no gate but sits among the gated rules
